# Paths held to the strict lint standard (pylint >= 9.9, isort, flake8).
#
# Every line is a git pathspec, resolved with `git ls-files`. Add a directory
# here once its scripts are clean, so that coverage only ever grows; the CI
# job fails if a listed pattern stops matching anything, which is how the
# gate silently lost its files in #41.
#
# Everything else in the repository is still checked for actual errors
# (pylint --enable=E) by the other job in .github/workflows/pylint.yml.
#
# Current status (issue #42): the directories below are clean. The remaining
# hand-written scripts sit between 5 and 9.7; roughly half of their findings
# are trailing whitespace and over-long lines, so a mechanical pass plus
# isort brings most of them within reach of this gate.
